tool_input.body:
## Summary

Five workstreams extending formal (Z/ProB) coverage to the subsystems producing the current bug queue, executed as five ethos missions (m-2026-09-20-002…006, all closed pass by independent evaluators).

- **`docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex`** (new): path canonicalization + write-set admission. Reproduces ethos-vaib (leading-slash loss: `/docs/x.md` admitted under `docs/**`) and ethos-8ady (lint coverage heuristic's `HasSuffix(w,"/")` short-circuit) as recorded ProB counter-examples; corrected semantics certified complete (5,790 states / 28,535 transitions).
- **`docs/spec-audit-durability.tex`** (new): audit-line durability across checkouts/worktrees/sessions. The current design reaches the ethos-015a loss state in one step (`git worktree remove`, no hook fires). Of three candidate fixes, only the per-machine spool satisfies the safety property unconditionally — the verdict section is the formal input to bead ethos-ss2x (SQLite direction).
- **`docs/spec-hook-gates.tex`** (new): composed SubagentStart verifier gate + PreToolUse write gate. The silent-disabled state (verifier of an open mission, no gate, no diagnostic) is reachable under today's mute empty-MISSION_ID skip; unreachable under a loud-skip variant that changes diagnostics only (respects ethos-yf6n's do-not-fix triage).
- **`docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex`** (re-baseline): DES-076 abandon semantics (aborted never blocks; `--disclaim`), DES-072 excluded with cited argument, traceability refreshed to 244b6c3, currency rule added (also in `docs/development.md`).
- **`Makefile` + CI** (ethos-cy70): `fuzz-check` target in `make check` — content-detected Z specs (recursive, bracket-tolerant pattern), loud local skip, hard CI failure on missing fuzz or empty detection; CI installs fuzz from punt-labs/z-spec v0.20.5.

## Why

Root-cause analysis of the last month's ~40 bugs showed the majority are semantic defects in enforcement and record-integrity paths whose rules existed only as implementations. This PR pins those rules as tool-checked models with counter-example regression nets, and puts a drift gate in `make check` so the specs cannot rot silently again (the existing lifecycle spec had drifted for six weeks).

## Review yield (beyond the specs)

- **New P2 code bug found and filed: ethos-fhns** — `Store.Update` lacks the terminal-state guard every other mutating operation has and can reopen a closed mission. The spec discloses the divergence; the Go fix is separate work.
- Also filed: ethos-x6z6 (shared-session audit seal bundles foreign missions' bookkeeping into commits), ethos-nr7b (AdvanceRound unreachable in the lifecycle model's exploration).
- Every recorded ProB count was independently reproduced by an evaluator or corrected; unstable deadlock-search counts are now reported as ranges with an explicit search-order caveat.

## Verification playbook

- `make check` green end-to-end at HEAD (golangci-lint, shellcheck, ruff/mypy/pytest, markdownlint 332 files, `go test -race` all packages, validate-content, fuzz over all five Z specs).
- Independent evaluator re-runs (jra ×4 missions, kth ×1): fuzz 0 errors per spec; ProB `model_check` counts reproduced exactly for every full-exploration row; counter-example traces reproduced (vaib, 8ady, 015a-loss, abandon fail-open, mute-skip deadlock).
- Gate exercised: broken Z construct in a fixture fails `make fuzz-check`; `FUZZ_SPECS= CI=true` hard-fails (empty-detection guard); missing-binary CI hard-fail and local loud-skip both demonstrated.
- `pdflatex -halt-on-error` exits 0 on all four specs (4 build-breaking text-mode math errors found by review and fixed).
- Local review: seeded `code-reviewer`, `silent-failure-hunter`, `invariant-completeness-reviewer` ran on the full diff; all findings fixed in committed fix rounds (or dismissed with recorded reasons: specs-outside-docs/ detection scope; cosmetic citation-style nit).

Docs-only for runnable-code purposes except `Makefile`/CI (exercised above) and one comment-line fix in `internal/mission/store_test.go`.

Beads: closes ethos-q9fn, ethos-6y4p, ethos-mr1z, ethos-ixl7, ethos-cy70.

tool_input.message:
PR #530 external review round: 3 items for you on feat/z-spec-state-machines (Makefile + .github/workflows/test.yml only; commit with make check green; report commit hash and evidence for the Bugbot rebuttal).

1. Copilot (valid) — pin the punt-labs/z-spec checkout to the immutable commit instead of the mutable tag: ref: 2d50236d81b1438f7e104fda18ff07d4f446cb60 (I resolved refs/tags/v0.20.5 to that SHA via the GitHub API just now) with a trailing comment "# v0.20.5". Matches the repo's action-pinning convention.

2. Copilot (valid) — Makefile:~136: grep's --include is GNU-only; on macOS BSD grep the $(shell) yields empty FUZZ_SPECS and the local branch reports a clean skip, silently omitting every spec for macOS developers. Replace with a portable detection, e.g. `find docs -name '*.tex' -exec grep -El 'usepackage(\[[^]]*\])?\{fuzz\}' {} +` (verify -E and the brace escaping behave identically under GNU and BSD grep; if -E portability of the pattern is in doubt, use a shell loop with grep -q). Re-verify: all five specs detected; empty+CI hard-fail still works; broken-fixture failure still propagates.

3. Bugbot HIGH (verify then rebut or fix) — claims v0.20.5 "is not a published z-spec release (latest is v0.20.4), and current install.sh has no --fuzz-only flag and never builds fuzz". The tag exists publicly (I verified: refs/tags/v0.20.5 → 2d50236). Verify the OTHER half against the pinned commit as served by GitHub (not your local clone): fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/punt-labs/z-spec/2d50236d81b1438f7e104fda18ff07d4f446cb60/install.sh and confirm --fuzz-only exists and builds fuzz. If confirmed, the finding needs no code change beyond item 1's SHA pin — write me one paragraph of evidence (flag name + line numbers in that file) for the reply comment. If NOT confirmed at that commit, fix the workflow to whatever the real install surface is and say so.

Do not touch docs/ (I have an uncommitted development.md fix pending — commit only your two files).
